blocks.heading: Simple & Robust ELT Data Pipelines from any data source to any data warehouse
blocks.body:
### Ever expanding collection of supported data sources

We have 100+ pre-built & rigousuly tested integrations for all popular cloud apps and data sources. Cannot find an integration you need? Just reachout to us, we will be happy to build the integration for you.

blocks.heading: Choose your Data Warehouse
blocks.body: We support all popular cloud data warehouses like Google Bigquery, AWS Redshift, Snowflake & many more. Choose to configure your own warehouse or select a DataChannel managed warehouse. Decide which region your data resides in.

blocks.heading: Pre & post-load data transformations
blocks.body: Write your data transformations in native SQL and schedule them with DataChannel to execute directly in your data warehouse. Set up dependencies on data pipelines to ensure data freshness and integrity

blocks.heading: “DataChannel makes ETL easy, effective & efficient.” - Tom Murray
blocks.body:
**Managing Director, Jump 450 Media**

All we did was set up a few pipelines by entering our credentials and tweaking some source-specific parameters like breakdown criteria, frequency of update, etc. to suit our client’s needs, and that’s it. Now, thirty different sources are being automatically aggregated & delivered into our AWS Redshift warehouse, at a granularity and frequency of our choosing without us ever writing a single piece of code whatsoever.
